FOUND ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG in CollegesManager.jsx: run() helper does not return the inner promise, so buttons chaining .then() on run() (Add Course save, Edit Course save, Edit College save) throw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading then)' after a successful API call — Add Course still writes the course to DB but the modal freeze / error overlay makes course-edit and college-edit save flows unusable.

ui_bugs.issue: run(fn) helper doesn't return the promise; three onClick handlers chain .then() on the return value and crash with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading then)' after the API call succeeds. Affected buttons: college-add-course-save-<id> (line 132), college-course-save-<id> (line 32), college-save-<id> (line 83). The API side-effect DOES happen (course/college is created/updated) but the UI freezes with Emergent runtime-error overlay and the modal never closes / form never resets. Fix: `const run = (fn) => { setBusy(true); return fn().then(...).catch(...).finally(...); };` — add the `return` keyword in both CourseRow (line 14-20) and CollegeCard (line 65-71) run helpers.

issues: Recurring React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' due to Emergent code-editor overlay attributes injected into <option> nodes — noise only in dev preview, not application code.

action_items: Fix CollegesManager.jsx run() helper — add `return` so `.then()` chaining works. Locations: line 14-20 (CourseRow) and line 65-71 (CollegeCard). This is the ONE blocking bug found in this iteration; everything else (11/12 features) passed end-to-end.

The one bug (CollegesManager run() missing return) is trivial (add one keyword). After main agent fixes, re-run only the /admin/colleges UI flow — everything else is green.
rca of the issue: CollegesManager.jsx defines `const run = (fn) => { setBusy(true); fn().then(...).catch(...).finally(...) };` — no return. Callers write `onClick={() => run(() => addCourse(...)).then(() => { setAddOpen(false); ... })}` expecting run() to be a thenable. Because run returns undefined, the `.then()` immediately throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading then)' AFTER the successful API round-trip — so the DB write happens (visible under Add Course + Edit Course + Edit College Save paths) but the UI freezes with the Emergent runtime-error overlay and setAddOpen(false)/setEdit(false)/setEditMeta(false) never fires. Reproduction: /admin/colleges → Add College → Add Course → fill name → Save → success alert never shown, but a subsequent GET /api/colleges shows the course exists. Fix: prepend `return` to `fn().then(...)` in both `run` helpers (lines 14-20 and 65-71); no test needed on the API side.
